source:
@@U04692@@
love divine rising!
Arrows, come, pierce my flesh,
lances, come, master me,
bludgeons, come, batter me,
lightning, come, shatter me,
till all that is vanity
is purged away,
leaving the star to shine,
kernel of Love divine.

@@U04694@@
(in the lower region.)

@@U04695@@
Abyss rests on abyss at my feet;
a thousand rills join the great fall
to plunge below into foaming depths;
of its own urge the towering tree
rises high into pure air:
just as all-powerful Love
shapes and shields all things.
What a roaring tumult about me,
as if all Nature surged like the sea!
And yet it is only the wealth of waters
tumbling in love to the valley below;
the lightning blast has cleared the air
of poison and evil mist:
and all this done in love—
proclaiming the Creative Spirit
that ever wraps us round in glory!
May it light a holy flame
to stir my cold mind,
my dulled senses,
lost in anguish,
bound in chains of
doubt and torment!
God!
Bless me with your light!
translation:
@@U04692@@
爱神崛起！
箭，来吧，刺穿我的肉，
长矛，来吧，主宰我，
棍棒，来吧，殴打我，
闪电，来吧，粉碎我，
直到一切都是虚空
被清除掉，
留下星星的光芒，
神圣之爱的核心。

@@U04694@@
（在下部区域。）

@@U04695@@
深渊就在我脚下的深渊；
千条小溪汇成大瀑布
潜入泡沫深处；
参天大树自身的冲动
高高地升入纯净空气中：
就像全能的爱一样
塑造并保护万物。
我周围有多么喧闹的喧嚣，
仿佛整个大自然都像大海一样汹涌澎湃！
然而这只是水的财富
爱上下面的山谷；
闪电已经净化了空气
毒气与邪雾：
而这一切都是在爱中完成的——
宣扬创造精神
永远将我们包裹在荣耀之中！
愿它点燃神圣的火焰
来搅动我冰冷的心灵，
我迟钝的感官，
迷失在痛苦中，
束缚在链条中
怀疑和折磨！
上帝！
用你的光芒祝福我！
